The '''Caloria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Reena Province]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="PGT" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Caloria/Legends|Caloria]].<ref name="LE" /> The Caloria system lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Caloria Run/Legends|Caloria Run]], which connected it to the [[Canti system/Legends|Canti]] and [[Tanger system/Legends|Tanger systems]]. The Caloria system was a major system of [[House Reena/Legends|House Reena]].<ref name="PGT" />
